status.description: done is set by QA alone; merged is the light tier's terminal status, set by the controller after the merge, and carries no acceptance

tier.description: the verification tier, set at dispatch and changed only by `pk status tier` with a ruling; absent (a record written before 0.3.0) means full

fast.description: the fast path: BRIEF.md and a ruling replace SPEC, PLAN and spec QA; never true on the full tier

ruling.description: the ruling (R<n>) that allowed the fast path or the last tier change; empty when none was needed

evidence.description: paths relative to the project root

tier.description: present on the entry a tier change appends
